articles.image_title: Hapag-Lloyd: Hapag-Lloyd and other shipping containers stacked up in the port of Jebel Ali on the 29th of December 2024 in Dubai United Arab Emirates. Jebel Ali is run by DP World and is the world's ninth busiest port, the largest man-made harbour, and the biggest and by far the busiest port in the Middle-East.
